items: AI speeds up the direction you already have, so settle your strategy and guest journey first and then use AI to execute it faster.
Without a clear strategy, AI produces dashboards nobody checks, automation nobody trusts and systems that solve problems nobody had.
Vertical AI built into specific workflows like scheduling, routing and responding pulls ahead because it understands the context of your business.
Ask where AI supports your strategy, which manual decisions you could automate with confidence, and how to scale what works without bloating your team or tech stack.
